programme.title: Fudbal - Španska liga: Malaga - Racing 07.11.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Basketball - Eurocup: Siauliai - Tenerife
programme.desc: Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second competition of Euroleague Basketball. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues participate in it. Placement in the Eurocup is secured through national championships and cups, and through invitations to the so-called wildcards. The second strongest competition in European basketball was created by the merger of the FIBA ​​Radivoje Korać Cup and the Saporta Cup. The significance of this competition is that the winner secures the right to participate in the next season in the strongest club basketball competition in Europe, the Euroleague.

programme.title: Košarka - ABA liga: Cibona - FMP
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season.

programme.title: Basket 3x3 - World Tour: Zaisan, grupna faza
programme.desc: Fiba World Tour 3 na 3 za razliku od World Cupa uključuje momčadi iz pojedinih gradova dok na World Cup pravo natjecanja imaju nacionalni timovi. Kao vrhunac 3 na 3 košarke World Tour natjecanje pod okriljem Fibe od 2012. godine mami uzdahe ljubitelja ovog dinamičnog sporta. Temeljna razlika između klasične dvoranske košarke je broj igrača na terenu, a to je po tri u svakoj momčadi. Bitne razlike su još, da se igra na polovici standardnog košarkaškog terena na jedan koš. Utakmica traje deset minuta ili ukoliko jedna momčad prva dođe do 21 poena meč se automatski prekida.

programme.title: Giroud: The 40th birthday dinner
programme.desc: Quoi de mieux que d'être entouré de ses proches pour passer le cap de la quarantaine ? Canal+ a décidé de célébrer l'anniversaire d'Olivier Giroud en réunissant autour de lui ses amis. Dans un restaurant lillois, l'attaquant champion du monde a dîné en compagnie des consultants Christophe Jallet et Robert Pirès, mais également de son ami, l'ancien international Mathieu Debuchy. Pendant plus d'une heure, l'ancien buteur des Bleus se livre comme rarement : sa future reconversion, les critiques sur son parcours, les transferts manqués, les treize ans à l'étranger, l'armoire à trophées. Sans oublier des messages d'anniversaire surprises d'anciens coéquipiers, des anecdotes décalées sur sa riche carrière et les bougies soufflées !

programme.title: Extreme passions
programme.desc: We follow extreme runners along the ridges of Moorea. From physical preparation to the final race, we experience their training and the vibrations of the race to take on this extreme challenge. The Xterra race in Polynesia is distinguished by its demanding course and breathtaking landscapes. Among the notable athletes, Cédric Wane, a local champion, embodies the spirit of trail running in Polynesia. The Xterra in Polynesia is a real challenge for him. It is an experience that links sporting competition and human adventure.

programme.title: Les enfants de Teahupo'o

Longtemps réservée à l'élite du surf mondial, elle est aujourd'hui apprivoisée par une nouvelle génération de surfeurs locaux, dont Kelia Galina, Gilbert Teave et Tahurai Henry. Tous défendent un mode de vie authentique, bouleversé par l'arrivée des Jeux olympiques.

programme.title: Little Big Fred
programme.desc: Il a passé sa vie entière sous les projecteurs, avant d'être aspiré par ses ténèbres intérieures. Désormais consultant, Fred Weis a été un joueur de basket au talent précoce et un précurseur. Du haut de ses 2,17m, le pivot a porté l'équipe de France jusqu'à la finale des Jeux olympiques 2000 face aux Etats-Unis et a prouvé que la fluidité et l'intelligence de jeu n'étaient pas réservées aux petits gabarits. Courtisé par les plus grands clubs, en Europe comme aux Etats-Unis, il renonce finalement à faire le grand saut vers la NBA préférant revenir soutenir son club de coeur, Limoges. Sa carrière exemplaire est subitement chamboulée par la découverte de l'autisme de son fils, un choc qui l'entraine dans une spirale autodestructrice, jusqu'à envisager les solutions les plus radicales.

programme.title: Danger Has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: An amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry from Li Han Hsiang, recreating some of the era's funniest and most surreal stories ripped straight from the gossip.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: There is an old grudge between families among the Ching and Ming supporters in Kwang Tung. Some years later, Liang's son Hsiao-hu returns to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei stars as a young singer, Hsiao-Yun, struggles between her success in career and her relationship with her pianist lover Li Yen-nan.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Acclaimed actor Danny Lee plays a motorbike workshop owner who injured during an illegal motorcycle race and continues to race regardless of the physical consequences and the law.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: A dedicated wife uncovers a web of blackmail and deceit after her husband is conned by a conniving belly dancer. When the dancer is stabbed, things quickly go from bad to insane.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: This is a tragic tale about a young girl, played by Ivy Ling Po, who gets married and has five kids. She and her husband later die, forcing one child to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: The Kung-Fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: Humiliated swordsman Chin Wu-hsin is charged with finding the Supreme Sword of Old Eagle, only to retrieve it using foul play. This leads Old Eagle's own son to avenge his father.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Lo Wei helms this poetic romance that proves a perfect showcase for Ivy Ling Po's incredible talents, as a young scholar manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Martial arts legend Chan Koon Tai plays a city gang leader, who runs his operation out of a local cafe in this gritty, crime drama from director Kuei Chih Hung.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. The union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: With the destruction of the Shaolin Temple, five students must each learn Shaolin techniques in order to defeat their Ching adversaries. But there's a ''traitor'' amongst them, but who is it?

programme.title: Sex, Love And Hate
programme.desc: In Sex, Love And Hate, director of erotica and kung-fu films Chu Yuan combines stars from both genres to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from it.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: The evil minister uses the twelve golden medallions, the highest imperial decree, to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Ti Lung who lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with his brothers the Black Snake and the Yellow Snake, have been trying to turn into humans for a thousand years.

programme.title: All Men Are Brothers
programme.desc: The patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: Shaw Bros and TVB stars unite for Wang Feng's ensemble epic. Trouble is brewing when a gangster plans to change the Gossip Street residents' favourite hangout into a gambling den.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Set on the eve of the Japanese invasion of HK, this tragic Shaw Brothers romance stars Li Ting and Kwan Shan as young lovers torn apart by war.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and she confronts him when she finds herself pregnant.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Lily Ho portrays the feared swordswoman Silver Fox, who witnessed her father senselessly wounded and her mother raped. 18 years later it's payback time.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs to teach her martial arts skills.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and taking revenge.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Hsiao Fang is a young girl not afraid to fight back against hooligans. Unfortunately, she mistakes the handsome Ma Ta-hai, for one such hoodlum. The two are immediately attracted but refuse to admit their true feelings.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Another film inspired by the Chinese classic tale Journey to the West. This memorable version presents a unique interpretation with humour, action, and fantasy galore.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: In Pale Passion, Chin Ping-hsings only directed film, the gorgeous Chiang Li-ping plays a scorned wife Ah Hsia in an unsettling tale about cheating, adultery and blatant abuse, which develops into a deadly love triangle.

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master named 'Shadow Whip', he is suspected and hunted.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is one of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When he starts to question the morality of his missions, he becomes a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu depicts the glamourous world of nightclub performers in this story about two struggling sisters, played by Irene Chen Yi Ling and Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Li Ching, a 17-year-old girl who marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when Li decides to go to the same school with her husband but attempting to hide their relationship.

programme.title: The Web Of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called 'Five Poison Web', spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Ching Li stars in the story of two students looking to persuade their parents to bless their marriage. The lovebirds hatch what they think is a foolproof plan: they play dead!

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: As a scholar and his lover are torn apart forever by his uncle and his friend, and drive the girl to commit suicide. The girl returns as ghost and seek revenge.

programme.title: The Land Of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women give birth to baby girls by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Return Of The Phoenix
programme.desc: Return Of The Phoenix is yet another masterpiece from director Li Han-hsiang. It is a comedy surrounded the upcoming marriage of the imperial minister's daughter.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town.

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Perennial martial-arts villain Shek Kin takes on a rare comedic role as a playful ghost who befriends a young boy and helps him reunite his feuding parents.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition, he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Ming is a mole in the police department and Yan is a police mole in the Triads. Leading parallel lives, Ming and Yan are feeling increasingly trapped in their false surroundings and they're desperate to find a way out.

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Miss Qiao had died in vain and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge and a series of horrible events begins to happen.

programme.title: How To Pick Girls Up!
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective suffers a fatal accident involving a mysterious medallion and is transformed into an immortal warrior with superhuman powers.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Never take your mistress on an annual guys' getaway, especially one devoted to hunting - a violent lesson for three wealthy married men.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: The whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition. As Ip Man decides to step up and rise to the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: A failed assassination attempt in Harbin, China in 1909 changes the course of history. Now two JBI agents must find the connections between it and an ancient Korean artifact.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: This refreshing musical comedy tempers its fizzy charm with just enough tartness to insure its charming buoyancy. This light look at teenage life even won starlet Chou Hsiu-lan a Hong Kong Film Awards nomination for Best Newcomer.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Action superstar Chow Yun-Fat portrays real-life gangster Chen Daqi as he rises to the upper echelons of power, finding himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: A Taoist priest and his spirit companions must go separate ways after he decides to help a vampire-buster, who wants to defeat an evil witch and her henchmen.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: An imperial agent gets ridiculed for his various inventions, until his supportive wife encourages him to attend a conference, which's actually a trap to kill all the doctors serving the emperor, where his crazy inventions come in handy.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: When a young man ignores a feng shui master's warning and decides to marry before turning 30, a series of mishaps begins to curse his life.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: At a Hong Kong shopping center, Buck Yuen's (Jackie Chan's) intuition warns him. He saves a robbery's loot and gets on television, ends up in Istanbul via South Korea, and accidentally becomes a spy. Fortunately, he knows Kung Fu.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: A fantasy-horror set in present-day Moscow where the respective forces that control daytime and nighttime do battle.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: A supernatural mystery film with a detective investigating murders that seem to be the result of a curse.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 3
programme.desc: Police officer Chow Sing Sing is assigned to work undercover investigating the murder of millionaire Million Wong, to whom Chow has an uncanny resemblance, by posing as an amnesiac Wong.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic girl travels to Hong Kong in search of certain love but instead meets a kind-hearted professional fighter for whom she begins to fall instead.

programme.title: Cruel War (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin tests rubber seeds in Yinfan. Security agent Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife from the threat posed by drug kingpin Li Wenyao.

programme.title: The Great Magician (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A Chinese warlord hires a conjurer to help him impress a resistant concubine.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later passes and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is given the ability to resist the temptation from opposite sex but it becomes a burden when he is about to marry his girlfriend.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer is entangled with a 'woman in red', leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes also died mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This film tells the story of a Chinese illegal immigrant, Cheung Kwan-chow, and his journey in New York.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs 2
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Never Leave

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing created the gambling film genre almost singlehandedly, and in one of his earliest blockbusters, Shih Hsien leads a stellar cast in a tale of spies, tycoons and beautiful babes.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: The story of legendary Guan Yu crossing five passes And slaying six generals. He played a major role in the civil war that led to the collapse of Han Dynasty And the establishment of Shu Han of the 3 Kingdoms, making Liu Bei its first emperor.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Cinta Berakhir Bahagia Adisty
programme.desc: Adisty, tulang punggung keluarganya, hampir terjerumus menjadi pekerja seks komersial demi melunasi utang-utang keluarganya. Namun, takdir mempertemukannya dengan Pasha, seorang pria terhormat dari keluarga kaya raya. Tanpa mereka sadari, ternyata keduanya tertukar saat masih bayi. programme.desc: Program yang menayangkan Film dari berbagai genre seperti romansa dan komedi yang seru dan menghibur untuk disaksikan selama moment liburan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Terbelenggu Rindu Amira

Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: Ligue1
programme.desc: E10Magazyn sportowy poświęcony rozgrywkom francuskiej Ligue 1. Prezentowane są w nim skróty wszystkich meczów minionego weekendu oraz bramki.

programme.title: Dramatyczne rzuty karne
programme.desc: Rzuty karne w piłce nożnej to ogromne emocje towarzyszące zarówno biorącym w nich udział piłkarzom, jak i obserwującym je kibicom. Szczęście, nerwy ze stali i umiejętności techniczne są potrzebne, by dobrze wykonywać rzuty karne. Umiejętność ta jest bardzo ważna, bo strzały z jedenastu metrów rozstrzygały o losach niejednego ważnego spotkania.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Venezia FC - Udinese Calcio
programme.desc: Trener Kosta Runjaić zapłacił posadą za słabe wyniki Udinese. Jego następcą został Javier Zanetti, który zadebiutuje w roli szkoleniowca Zebr w meczu przeciwko Venezii. Arancioneroverdi są jednymi z ich bezpośrednich rywali w walce o utrzymanie.

programme.title: Najlepsi napastnicy Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Stefan Kuntz, Mario Basler, Fredi Bobic, Ulf Kirsten, Toni Polster i wielu innych zachwycało kibiców swoimi umiejętnościami na boiskach Bundesligi w latach 90. ubiegłego stulecia. W programie przyjrzymy się sylwetkom łowców bramek i oczywiście najpiękniejszym golom w ich bogatych kolekcjach.

programme.title: HHH - Hamburger SV
programme.desc: Widzowie zobaczą historię jednego z najważniejszych zespołów niemieckiej piłki. Hamburger SV sześć razy zdobywał tytuł mistrza Niemiec. Aktualnie drużyna gra w 2. Bundeslidze i stara się wrócić do elity niemieckiej piłki klubowej.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Borussii Dortmund
programme.desc: Michael Zorc, Stéphane Chapuisat, Robert Lewandowski, Andreas Moller to tylko niektórzy spośród piłkarzy Borussii Dortmund, którzy potrafili zdobywać bramki w zadziwiający sposób. W programie widzowie zobaczą najładniejsze gole w wykonaniu zawodników BVB.

programme.title: Birds of paradise
programme.desc: Filmowcy i dziennikarze zebrali w jednym miejscu ciekawostki dotyczące Bundesligi. Każdy znajdzie w tym filmie coś dla siebie, niemiecka liga bowiem to nie tylko sport, ale ogromne przedsięwzięcie dotykające różnych dziedzin życia takich jak ekonomia, socjologia moda i wiele innych.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Schalke 04
programme.desc: Barwy klubu FC Schalke 04 Gelsenkirchhen reprezentowało wielu klasowych snajperów, m.in. Klaus Fischer, Klaas-Jan Huntelaar, Ebbe Sand, Kevin Kuranyi. W programie widzowie zobaczą najlepsze gole w historii drużyny z Gelsenkirchen.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: SC Freiburg - 1. FC Union Berlin
programme.desc: Freiburg imponuje formą. Po ośmiu kolejkach znajduje się na trzeciej lokacie i traci zaledwie 2 punkty do liderującego Bayernu Monachium. Przeskoczyć aktualnego mistrza Niemiec chce starciem z Unionem. Zespół z Berlina po fatalnym początku sezonu zaczął wstawać z kolan i w ostatnich meczach zdobył 6 oczek, tym samym przybliżając się do opuszczenia strefy spadkowej.

W rozgrywkach 2003/2004 trenerem zespołu z Bremy był Thomas Schaaf. Zielono-białe barwy reprezentowali wówczas m.in. Angelos Charisteas,Christian Schulz i Frank Baumann.

programme.desc: FC Porto nadal może pochwalić się kompletem zwycięstw w lidze. Ma ich już na koncie 10, a w poprzednim meczu pokonało Estoril 4:0. O przedłużenie tej imponującej serii podopieczni Francesco Farioliego powalczą w 11. kolejce na wyjeździe z Vitorią SC.

programme.title: Najlepsi pomocnicy Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Thomas Haessler, Christian Ziege, Mehmet Scholl, Stefan Effenberg, Andreas Moller... w latach 90. po boiskach niemieckiej Bundesligi biegało wielu świetnych pomocników. Piłkarze grający na tej pozycji walnie przyczynili się do sukcesów reprezentacji Niemiec w ostatniej dekadzie XX wieku.

programme.title: Najlepsi bramkarze Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Biografie najlepszych bramkarzy lat 90., którzy zapisali się w historii niemieckiej ekstraklasy. Widzowie poznają życiorysy Olivera Kahna, Gabora Kiraly'a, Jensa Lehmanna czy Dirka Heynena.

programme.title: Legendy Bundesligi
programme.desc: Biografie postaci, które trwale zapisały się w historii niemieckiej Bundesligi. W programie m.in. wywiady z zasłużonymi piłkarzami oraz klubowymi działaczami. Widzowie zapoznają się także z wypowiedziami ekspertów piłkarskich.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Cagliari Calcio - Frosinone Calcio
programme.desc: Frosinone jest jedną z niespodzianek pierwszej części sezonu. Obecnie znajduje się na szóstej lokacie i traci zaledwie 3 punkty do miejsc pozwalających na grę w Lidze Mistrzów. Przybliżyć się do nich chce starciem z notującym spadek formy Cagliari. Zespół z Sardynii przegrał 4 ostatnie mecze ligowe i spadł na dwunastą pozycję.

programme.title: Dramatyczne rzuty karne
programme.desc: Rzuty karne w piłce nożnej to ogromne emocje towarzyszące zarówno biorącym w nich udział piłkarzom, jak i obserwującym je kibicom. Szczęście, nerwy ze stali i umiejętności techniczne są potrzebne, by dobrze wykonywać rzuty karne. Umiejętność ta jest bardzo ważna, bo strzały z jedenastu metrów rozstrzygały o losach niejednego ważnego spotkania.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Bayernu Monachium

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: VfB Stuttgart - Werder Brema
programme.desc: Werder Brema w ubiegły weekend przedłużył serię bez porażki, wygrywając 2:0 z TSG Hoffenheim. W najbliższej kolejce podopieczni Daniela Thioune zagrają na wyjeździe z VfB Stuttgart. Gospodarze również sięgnęli po trzy punkty w poprzedniej serii spotkań, pokonując 4:2 Bayer Leverkusen.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Toulouse FC - RC Strasbourg
programme.desc: Strasbourg w poprzedniej kolejce ograł Auxerre 5:1 i tym samym wydostał się ze strefy spadkowej. Teraz chce rozpocząć pogoń za ligową czołówką, do której traci 5 punktów. Przybliżyć się do niej spróbuje pojedynkiem z Toulouse. Gospodarze zanotowali spadek formy, zdobywając tylko oczko w ostatnich dwóch seriach gier, nie trafiając przy tym do bramki rywala.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Estrela Amadora - SL Benfica
programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Paris Saint-Germain - ESTAC Troyes
programme.desc: Po gorszym początku sezonu Paryżanie wrócili do poziomu, którym zachwycali kibiców na całym świecie. W poprzedniej serii spotkań wygrali z Le Havre AC aż 5:1. W 10. kolejce Paris Saint-Germain podejmie ESTAC Troyes. Przyjezdni odnieśli ostatnio drugie ligowe zwycięstwo w tym sezonie, pokonując 2:0 Le Mans FC.

programme.title: Fudbal - Engleska liga: Nottingham Forest - Manchester City
programme.desc: Every August, 20 teams begin the hunt for the most prized trophy in English football. The English Premier League in the format in which it is played today was founded in 1992 as a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts until May in a two-round system where each team plays 38 games throughout the season. The first winner of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being the champion of England is the goal that every Premier League player strives for.

programme.title: Game plan
programme.desc: The football coach and analyst will talk about how football looks and how it should look, using the example of several games from the Premier League. We will try to focus on football itself, not to leave the football field, and to give an answer to the question of what separates the teams into those that lose and those that win, that is, they often win. Our guests, football experts, will also give their opinion.

programme.title: Basketball - NBA league: Houston - Denver
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA League, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide on the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers.

programme.title: Fudbal - Španska liga: Valencia - Real Madrid
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. Along with the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the highly technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Partizan - Baskonia
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league: Parma - UNICS
programme.desc: The VTB League brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia also participate in the league. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, other clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, of which the best placed becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Panathinaikos - Barcelona
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.
